**Observations on test image:**
- Mango leaf with brown necrotic lesion concentrated at the tip area (~1/4 of leaf)
- Scattered small brown spots along the leaf surface
- Rest of leaf is healthy green

**Comparison with references:**
- **Anthracnose**: Bottom-right panel of the collage shows a very similar pattern — green leaf with brownish lesions at tip/margin area, scattered smaller spots. Matches "semicircular lesions on margins of young leaves" from symptom descriptions.
- **Bacterial_Canker**: Shows uniform marginal necrosis along entire serrated leaf edge — very different from test image.
- **Gall_Midge**: Shows distinct round blister galls distributed along margins — not matching the necrotic tip pattern.

The test image strongly matches Anthracnose: brown lesions at leaf tip/margin with tan-to-brown coloring and scattered spots.
